summary: E2E frontend testing of Sala de Operaciones module. All frontend changes verified against spec: surgeon select bound to /api/doctors; anesthesia options exactly [Tópica, Local, Local Asistida, General]; institution options exactly [Novavision, Alquiler, Seguro Privado, IGSS]; Seguro Privado reveals required insurance_name field; IGSS reveals Datos IGSS block; Novavision/Alquiler show no extra fields; validation blocks save when insurance_name missing; successful save with Seguro Privado persists all fields correctly (institution=Seguro Privado, insurance_name='TEST Seguros G&T', anesthesia_type='local_asistida', surgeon from doctors list); detail view displays insurance_name. Migrated legacy surgeries (3 remaining) all have valid anesthesia/institution values. Test surgery cleaned up via UI delete.

issues: Minor a11y: DialogContent missing aria-describedby (React warning in console); no data-testid on 'Guardar registro' / 'Cancelar' buttons nor on anesthesia/institution Select triggers inside dialog (only surgeon trigger has one). Adding would simplify future automated testing.

critical_code_review_comments: SalaOperaciones.js is ~1521 lines — consider splitting into subcomponents (SurgeryFormDialog, SurgeryDetailDialog, SurgeryTable) for maintainability.
Add data-testid to anesthesia-type trigger, institution trigger, save button, and eye-selector buttons to improve testability (currently tests rely on nth(1)/nth(2) ordering of comboboxes).
